directoryTitle:

directoryIntro: Explore the trades, technicians and professionals your operation needs. Compare responsibilities, assess the right capabilities and build a clear hiring brief.
directoryNote: These profiles describe recruitment specialisms, not available candidates. Suitability, availability and service scope are confirmed for your requirement.
directoryHeading: Build your team, role by role.
directoryHelp: Search a skill or role, then narrow the results by industry and workforce type.
hiring: What employers should consider when hiring
sourceNote: References inform the occupational guidance. Local rules, licensing and employer requirements must be checked for the actual destination and duties.
briefPrompt: Start with the duties, worksite and number of people you need. We can discuss the assessment and recruitment support appropriate to your brief.
fallback: The detailed role guidance and role-specific FAQs are currently available in English. Navigation and enquiry controls follow your selected language.
planningNote: The stages below are planning checkpoints. GlobalPath coordinates sourcing, assessment, documentation and arrival support within the agreed service scope. Employers make selection decisions; authorities decide permissions.
stageBriefBody: Agree duties, headcount, work location, employment terms and the assessment standard before sourcing begins.
stageAssessBody: Review relevant evidence, agree practical or technical assessments and arrange employer interviews. Record the selection decision and any training gaps.
stagePrepareBody: Confirm role-specific records, applicable permissions and who owns each step. Keep proposed travel dates conditional on the necessary decisions.
stageJoinBody: Confirm induction, supervision, accommodation and arrival contacts. Agree ongoing support and responsibilities in writing.
formTitle:
Tell us about
the team you need.
formIntro: Prepare a workforce brief for our recruitment team. Start with the essentials; add technical details where they help explain your requirement.
multipleRoles: Multiple roles / discuss with the team
quantityHelp: Leave blank if headcount is still being planned.
detailHelp: Include equipment, shifts, contract duration, assessment needs or other roles. Please do not include passports, CVs or sensitive personal records.
formPrivacy: Details stay in this form until you open your email app or download a copy. This website does not submit or store your enquiry. Review the message and send it from your email app.
unconfigured: Our enquiry email is awaiting verification. You can prepare and download your brief now; it cannot be emailed to our team from this page yet.
emailOpened: Your email app was requested. Your enquiry has not been sent. Review it and press Send in your email app. If no app opens, download your brief instead.
downloaded: Your brief is ready to download. Nothing has been sent to our team.
longBrief: This brief is too long for a reliable email link. Download it and attach it to an email to the address below.
requiredNote: Fields marked * are required to prepare an email. You can download an incomplete brief at any time.
